decisions.reason: As the flagship citrus crate closely builds on existing agricultural crate knowledge and design capabilities, the firm can effectively assimilate market feedback and improve it.
Rackable pallets extend core pallet manufacturing and design knowledge, giving high absorptive capacity to learn from results and retain the product.
Spill-retention pallets require some environmental/safety knowledge but the firm's pallet expertise and cooperation with research institutions support learning and improvement.
Plastic pallets with load retainers are close to existing pallet offerings, so the firm can readily absorb market information and apply its engineering knowledge.
